details: Peace negotiations between the US and Iran have reportedly stalled as the conflict nears its two-month mark. President Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Iran's latest proposal, which included ending the war and reopening the Strait of Hormuz, while delaying the nuclear deal. This geopolitical uncertainty, coupled with rising oil prices (WTI crude surged above $99 per barrel), has contributed to increased volatility in Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP, with the Crypto Fear & Greed Index dropping.
title: US-Iran Peace Talks Stall, Heightening Market Uncertainty

details: The cryptocurrency market is on edge ahead of the US Federal Reserve's rate decision and Chairman Jerome Powell's upcoming press conference. This monetary policy event, combined with ongoing geopolitical uncertainty from stalled US-Iran talks, is expected to trigger significant price movements across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP, as well as altcoins. Futu News suggests a potential hawkish shift from the Fed, which could strengthen the US Dollar and suppress non-US currencies and gold.
title: Fed Rate Decision Anticipated to Drive Crypto Volatility

details: Aleš Michl, Governor of the Czech National Bank, delivered a speech at The Bitcoin Conference 2026, discussing the potential inclusion of Bitcoin in the central bank's foreign exchange reserves. A new study suggests that a 1% allocation to Bitcoin could increase expected returns while maintaining overall risk due to Bitcoin's low long-term correlation with traditional assets. Michl emphasized the need for conservative yet forward-thinking monetary policy and diversifying large reserves.
title: Czech Central Bank Considers Bitcoin for Reserve Diversification

details: A recent Department of Justice indictment of a US soldier who allegedly used classified intelligence to bet on the capture of a foreign leader highlights the national security risks associated with geopolitical prediction markets. These platforms, some of which run on public blockchains, offer incentives for insiders to leak classified information and can be exploited by adversaries to analyze trading data, manipulate sentiment, or influence policy outcomes. Over $1 billion has been traded on these markets since 2022, with volumes doubling year-over-year.
title: Geopolitical Prediction Markets Pose National Security Risks

details: Reports indicate that tech giant OpenAI missed its internal targets for weekly users and revenue in the last quarter. This news has contributed to a downturn in the technology sector, particularly affecting AI and data-center-focused stocks. The broader Nasdaq 100 also experienced declines, with investors questioning the sustainability of the AI boom amid a general "risk-off" sentiment.
title: OpenAI Misses Internal Targets, Weighing on AI Stocks
